selection_criterion: high n_questions x high drift-aware in-PDF coverage, scoped to PDFs with linked BSARD ground truth that is actually present in the canonical source PDF

definitions.doc_id: PDF stem on disk; physical file at RQ2_T02_DATA_LOADER/data/pdfs/<doc_id>.pdf
definitions.pdf_filename_db: Filename used by the corpus DB (articles.pdf_filename) and by T03 question_relevance.json
definitions.n_questions: BSARD questions whose ground-truth pdf_filenames include this PDF (counted once per question)
definitions.found: Unique bsard_ids in this PDF with verification_status='FOUND' (deduped on (bsard_id, pdf_filename))
definitions.partial: Unique bsard_ids in this PDF with verification_status='PARTIAL'
definitions.not_found: Unique bsard_ids in this PDF with verification_status='NOT FOUND'
definitions.pct_found: found / (found + partial + not_found) — share per BSARD's pre-shipped verification flag (captured before some 2022-2024 abrogation laws took effect)
definitions.n_pages: Physical PyMuPDF page_count of the PDF on disk
definitions.n_in_pdf: Drift-aware: unique bsard_ids whose HF canonical article_text is currently a substring of the source PDF's raw_text (verdict==IN_PDF in drift_status.json)
definitions.n_abrogated: Drift-aware: unique bsard_ids replaced with <Abroge par ...> stub in the source PDF
definitions.n_partial_drift: Drift-aware: unique bsard_ids with a marker but no full HF text and no abrogation stub (typically TOC-only or format drift)
definitions.n_missing_drift: Drift-aware: unique bsard_ids with no Art. marker resolving in the source PDF
definitions.pct_in_pdf: n_in_pdf / (n_in_pdf + n_abrogated + n_partial_drift + n_missing_drift) — drift-aware analogue of pct_found, against the canonical source PDF
definitions.n_evaluable_questions: BSARD questions tied to this PDF whose GT bsard_ids intersect IN_PDF (i.e. at least one GT article is actually retrievable from the canonical source PDF)
definitions.n_drifted_questions: BSARD questions tied to this PDF whose GT bsard_ids are entirely absent from IN_PDF (cannot be evaluated on this PDF, even with a perfect retriever)

pdfs.notes: Drift filter applied 2026-05-06. The GT-vs-PDF drift documented for 2004A27101 (an excluded PDF) does not affect this one — the drift-aware verdict here is 264/265 questions evaluable.

removed_pdfs.reason: Drift-aware audit: only 11/347 BSARD-linked articles are actually IN_PDF (3.2% pct_in_pdf vs 85-98% for retained PDFs); 335 are <Abroge par L 2022-04-28/25, art. 62, 048; En vigueur : 01-01-2023> stubs. Of 131 questions tied to this PDF, 77 have all GT in the abrogated range (not evaluable, including sample q70). The original 91.6% pct_found rationale was based on BSARD's stale pre-2023 verification flag.
removed_pdfs.kept_artefacts: drift_status.json, t08_bundles/, configs/, results/ remain in place under RQ2_T03_ARM1_NAIVE/data/1804_03_21_1804032153/ as a worked example of the drift methodology.
